messages:
Hannah Lee: brief sync  spotted a mix of terms in examples: `model_name`, `model`, `modelVersion`, and `model_version`. This is confusing in the migration guide and SDK snippets. We should pick a single canonical doc term and show per-SDK casing.
Marco Ruiz: totally. My vote: docs canonical = `model_version` (explicit), with `model` used only in casual prose.
Priya Desai: +1 to `model_version`. Also we need a small paragraph in the style guide explaining "when to use concise prose vs explicit field names".
Hannah Lee: good call. I'll draft glossary text: `model_version (doc canonical)  the specific model artifact identifier used for inference (e.g., llama-3b-v2). Use model for general references.`
Marco Ruiz: also include a tiny SDK snippet block that shows both the doc canonical name and idiomatic SDK param names, e.g.:
```
# Docs canonical: model_version
# Python
resp = client.generate(model_version=\"llama-3b-v2\", prompt=\"hello\")

// Node
const res = await client.generate({ modelVersion: 'llama-3b-v2', prompt: 'hello' })
```
Priya Desai: add migration checklist: 1) grep for `modelVersion`/`model_name`/`model` in code blocks, 2) update quickstarts and guides, 3) add mapping table to migration notes, 4) ping SDK leads about non-breaking aliases.
docs-bot: Reminder: PRs that rename documented fields should include a short "impact" section and a changelog entry.
Hannah Lee: I'll open a PR with: glossary entry, style guide paragraph, three language snippets (Python/Node/Go), and a migration table. PR link will be posted here.
Marco Ruiz: small nit: for the glossary entry, add a link to the model catalog and an example of a stable model_version string.
Priya Desai: QA request: once PR is ready, can QA run a quick grep on onboarding emails and the cookbooks? Those are easy to miss.
QA Lead: happy to run the grep and report back. Add me as a reviewer on the PR.
Hannah Lee: PR opened (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4599  includes a mapping table and the suggested snippets.
Marco Ruiz: reviewing now. I'll flag any missed code blocks.
Priya Desai: :thumbsup: I can help sweep the quickstarts after merge.
Hannah Lee: thanks all. target merge by tomorrow EOD. :sparkles:
